    a[2] = 1

        # a[n] = a[a[n-1]] + a[n - a[n-1]]

def solve_a(n_limit):

    a[2] = 1
    for n in range(3, n_limit + 1):
        idx1 = a[n-1]
        idx2 = n - a[n-1]
        a[n] = a[idx1] + a[idx2]
    return a
